design_overview: A modern, patient-centric hospital appointment booking system designed for both mobile and web platforms. The interface prioritizes clarity, ease of navigation, and accessibility for users of all ages. The design employs a clean medical aesthetic with calming colors, clear visual hierarchy, and intuitive touch-friendly components. Each screen is purposefully crafted to guide patients through registration, appointment booking, and management while providing doctors with efficient tools to manage their availability.

screens.name: Doctor Search & Booking
screens.purpose: Allow patients to search for doctors by specialty, view availability, and book appointments

key_components.name: Specialty Filter Chips

key_components.name: Doctor List Card
key_components.styling: White card with doctor profile image (circular, 64px) on left, name in bold, specialty and department in secondary text, rating stars (gold) with review count, availability indicator (green dot + 'Available Today'), right arrow indicating tappable
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to doctor profile and availability screen

key_components.name: Availability Indicator
key_components.styling: Small rounded badge with green background, white text 'Available Today' or gray background 'Next available: Mon'
key_components.interaction: Visual indicator only, part of doctor card

key_components.name: Sort Options Button
key_components.styling: Text button with icon, 'Sort by: Availability' in secondary color, subtle underline
key_components.interaction: Opens bottom sheet with sort options (Availability, Rating, Distance, Name)

key_components.name: Results Count Text
key_components.styling: Secondary text color, '24 doctors found' displayed above list
key_components.interaction: Static informational text

key_components.name: Empty State Illustration
key_components.styling: Centered illustration with text 'No doctors found' and 'Try adjusting your filters' when search returns no results
key_components.interaction: Static display, shown only when no results

key_components.name: Filter Modal
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet modal with white background, rounded top corners, contains specialty checkboxes, availability toggles, distance slider, apply and reset buttons
key_components.interaction: Opened by filter icon, apply button filters results and closes modal, reset clears all filters

screens.user_flow: Accessed from home dashboard 'Find Doctor' button or 'Book Appointment' flow. Users search/filter doctors, tap a doctor card to view detailed profile and available time slots, then proceed to booking confirmation.

screens.name: Appointment Booking Confirmation

key_components.name: Header with Back Button
key_components.styling: White background, back arrow on left, 'Book Appointment' title centered
key_components.interaction: Back button returns to doctor search

key_components.name: Doctor Info Card

key_components.interaction: Static informational display

key_components.name: Appointment Summary Card

responsive_design: The design follows a mobile-first approach with responsive breakpoints for tablet and web. On mobile (320-428px), components stack vertically with full-width cards and single-column layouts. On tablet (768-1024px), appointment cards and doctor listings display in 2-column grids, and navigation moves to a side panel. On desktop (1280px+), the layout uses a 3-column grid for content cards, persistent side navigation, and wider spacing. All touch targets maintain minimum 44x44px size across devices. Typography scales proportionally using rem units. Images and cards maintain aspect ratios and use flexible containers.
accessibility: The design adheres to WCAG 2.1 AA standards. All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text. All icons are accompanied by text labels or ARIA labels. Form inputs include visible labels and placeholder text. Focus states are clearly visible with primary blue outlines. Screen reader support includes semantic HTML structure, proper heading hierarchy, and descriptive alt text for images. Error messages are clearly visible and associated with form fields. The app supports dynamic text sizing and works with screen readers like VoiceOver and TalkBack.
animations: Subtle, purposeful animations enhance usability without distraction. Screen transitions use 300ms slide animations (right to left for forward navigation, left to right for back). Card taps show 150ms scale animation (0.98 scale). Button presses show 100ms opacity change (0.8 opacity). Modal overlays fade in over 200ms. Toggle switches slide smoothly over 200ms. List items show staggered fade-in when loading (50ms delay between items). Pull-to-refresh uses native platform animations. Loading states show skeleton screens with subtle shimmer animation. Success confirmations use spring animations for checkmarks. All animations respect user's reduced motion preferences.
icons: Icons follow a consistent outline style with 2px stroke weight. Primary icons used throughout: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person silhouette), settings (gear), bell (notification bell), bookmark (ribbon), heart (health/favorites), filter (funnel), plus (add/create), edit (pencil), trash (delete), share (arrow). Icons are 24x24px by default, scaled to 20px for small contexts and 28px for prominent actions. All icons use the primary color (#0066CC) when active, gray (#757575) when inactive, and white on colored backgrounds. Icons are sourced from a consistent icon library (Feather Icons or similar) to maintain visual harmony.
